title: How much do Quants actually matter on modern models?
body: I've seen a lot of debate regarding quantizations, and I decided to run some head-to-head tests on my 5080 which has been running constantly over the past 2 weeks to gather data for this. When I get the response of "But no BF16 for 35B!" my answer is "There's a part 2 article coming with larger hardware", I wanted to do an article at 16GB as my audience has far more members with 16GB of VRAM then 32GB or 64GB.
